Diagnosis.submission: The frontend deployment has 2 replicas with a required podAntiAffinity rule (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) that prevents two frontend pods from running on the same node. The frontend pods mount a PersistentVolumeClaim (frontend-pvc) that uses ReadWriteOnce access mode backed by an OpenEBS local hostpath volume with node affinity pinned to kind-worker. The second frontend replica is stuck in Pending because the anti-affinity rule blocks it from scheduling on kind-worker (where the first replica runs and where the PV is available), and the PV node affinity conflict prevents scheduling on any other node. The combination of required pod anti-affinity, RWO PVC with hostpath node affinity, and 2 replicas makes scheduling impossible for the second pod.
